author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Keaton Winn (elbow) to begin throwing progression this week
desc: Keaton Winn is scheduled to begin a throwing progression by the end of the week.
impact: Winn was placed on the 15-day injured list June 14 after experiencing soreness following a throwing session. However, an MRI revealed no significant damage, and he is expected to return by early July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Clay Holmes (fibula) begins playing catch
desc: Clay Holmes has begun playing light catch.
impact: Holmes fractured his right fibula on a comebacker May 15. He has begun throwing, but is still in the early stages of his rehab and is not expected to return until August.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Victor Caratini (neck) could return Thursday
desc: Victor Caratini could return to the Minnesota Twins lineup for Thursday's game against the Texas Rangers.
impact: Caratini missed Monday's and Tuesday's games against the Rangers due to neck stiffness. With the Twins off on Wednesday, he'll look to return on Thursday and continue swinging a hot bat, as he owns a 1.045 OPS across 10 games in June.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jake Irvin (shoulder) throwing up to 75 feet
desc: Jake Irvin has progressed to throwing weighted balls and a baseball from distances of 60 and 75 feet.
impact: Irvin has been on the injured list since March 24 due to a right shoulder strain. He began throwing plyo balls in early June and has since progressed to throwing from distances of up to 75 feet. He remains without a clear timetable for return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Reese Olson (shoulder) begins throwing progression
desc: Reese Olson began a throwing progression on Monday.
impact: Olson has already been ruled out for the 2026 season after undergoing right shoulder labral repair on February 2. He has begun a throwing program, putting him on track to be ready for spring training.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jordan Beck (hamstring) completes running drills Tuesday
desc: Jordan Beck was seen stretching and completing running drills prior to Tuesday's game against the Chicago Cubs.
impact: Beck has been sidelined for a month due to a left hamstring strain, so it's encouraging that he was seen running on Tuesday. He remains without a clear timetable for return, as he has yet to be cleared for defensive drills.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Mickey Moniak (ankle) to begin rehab assignment Thursday
desc: Mickey Moniak is scheduled to begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Albuquerque on Thursday.
impact: Moniak is scheduled to play on Thursday, Friday and Saturday before returning to Denver for evaluation by the medical staff. He is nearing a return, and fantasy managers should expect him back before the end of the month.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Emilio Pagan (hamstring) to throw live BP Friday
desc: Emilio Pagan is scheduled to throw a live batting practice session on Friday.
impact: Pagan was cleared to face hitters on June 13 following an MRI exam. He threw a bullpen session on Tuesday and is scheduled to face hitters on Friday. He is expected to return by early July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Pierce Johnson (elbow) to begin rehab assignment Thursday
desc: Pierce Johnson is scheduled to begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Louisville on Thursday.
impact: Johnson threw a simulated game on Monday without any issues and will now begin a rehab assignment on Thursday. He is in line to be activated from the injured list before the end of the month.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Justin Steele (elbow) hopeful to resume throwing next week
desc: Justin Steele is hopeful to resume his throwing program on Monday.
impact: Steele has yet to pitch this season as he continues to recover from UCL surgery. He suffered a setback in April but is on track to resume throwing next week. He is expected to return at some point during the second half of the season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jovani Moran (elbow) receives cortisone injection
desc: Jovani Moran recently received a cortisone injection.
impact: Moran recently threw a bullpen session and subsequently received a cortisone injection to help reduce lingering inflammation. He will be shut down from throwing for a few days.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cade Povich (elbow) throws live BP Tuesday
desc: Cade Povich threw a live batting practice session on Tuesday.
impact: Povich has been on the 15-day injured list since May 8 with left elbow inflammation. He threw a live batting practice session on Tuesday without any issues and is tentatively scheduled to begin a rehab assignment with Double-A Chesapeake within the week.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Yaramil Hiraldo (shoulder) to throw live BP Friday
desc: Yaramil Hiraldo is scheduled to throw a live batting practice session on Friday.
impact: Hiraldo has been sidelined since April 2 with right shoulder inflammation. He has thrown multiple bullpen sessions and is scheduled to face live hitters for the first time on Friday. He is on track for a July activation from the injured list.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Dean Kremer (quad) throws live BP Tuesday
desc: Dean Kremer threw a live batting practice session on Tuesday.
impact: Kremer has been sidelined since April 23 with a right quadriceps strain but continues to make progress in his recovery. He completed his second live batting practice session without any issues on Tuesday and is tentatively scheduled to begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Norfolk within the week.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Brooks Kriske (shoulder) begins throwing program
desc: Brooks Kriske has begun a throwing program.
impact: Kriske has been on the injured list since May 13 with a right shoulder impingement. While he began a throwing progression last week, he remains without a timetable for his return.
